reports.title: Reconciliations of GAAP (reported) to Non-GAAP measures are in the attached financial tables. All results referenced throughout this release are on a continuing operations basis unless otherwise stated.

guidance.heading: GUIDANCE FOR FULL-YEAR AND FOURTH QUARTER 2026
section: The company now estimates reported sales growth for full-year 2026 of 48 to 49 percent versus prior guidance of 37 to 39 percent. This new guidance range reflects 38 to 39 percent organic sales growth versus prior guidance of 32 to 34 percent. The company now expects full-year 2026 EPS of $4.54 to $4.57 on a GAAP basis and adjusted EPS of $5.36 to $5.39, versus prior guidance of $4.29 to $4.39 on a GAAP basis and adjusted EPS of $5.00 to $5.10.

The company estimates fourth quarter 2026 reported sales growth of 45 to 48 percent and organic sales growth of 26 to 29 percent. The company estimates fourth quarter 2026 EPS on a GAAP basis of $1.13 to $1.16 and adjusted EPS of $1.30 to $1.33.
